extracted.name: Gnocchi traybake with lemony ricotta
extracted.description: Rustle up this one-tray wonder with gnocchi, ricotta, artichokes, plum tomatoes and courgette. It can be adapted by using any veg you have in the fridge
ingredient_lines: 1 courgette halved, then sliced into chunky pieces
100g artichokes in oil plus 2 tbsp of the oil
1 lemon zested, then sliced into wedges
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 8. Tip the gnocchi, courgette and tomatoes into a large roasting tray. Add the artichokes and oil, the bashed garlic cloves and chilli flakes, and season well with salt and freshly ground black pepper. Mix all the ingredients together with your hands, then bake for 30-35 mins until the gnocchi are crisp at the edges and the veg is soft.
Meanwhile, mix the ricotta and lemon zest together in a small bowl, then season with salt and pepper to taste. Dot this over the gnocchi and sprinkle over the basil.
Divide the gnocchi between two bowls, mixing them well so the ricotta breaks down to make a creamy sauce. Serve with the lemon wedges for squeezing over.
